recognize_zh: 中央一顆幾乎與紅血球同大的圓形血小板，內含粗大紫紅色顆粒、邊緣淡染，旁邊另有數顆正常大小的小血小板可對照，屬於巨大血小板，符合 Bernard-Soulier 症候群。
features: Giant platelet with a diameter nearly equal to adjacent red cells
Coarse purple-red granules distributed throughout, with a finely fringed pale periphery
Several normal-sized small platelets nearby for comparison
Normochromic red cells, some overlapping; image is high magnification with limited resolution
describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a giant platelet approximately equal in size to the neighboring red cells, containing coarse granules and a pale fringed periphery. Several normal-sized platelets are present nearby, and the red cells are normochromic. Findings indicate macrothrombocytes and, in the setting of thrombocytopenia, are consistent with Bernard-Soulier syndrome; confirmation with ristocetin-induced aggregation and platelet GPIb-IX flow cytometry is recommended.

ddx.vs: MYH9 disorders show Dohle-like inclusions in neutrophils and normal ristocetin aggregation.
ITP shows only mildly enlarged platelets and normal GPIb-IX expression.
Gray platelets are large but agranular and pale grey, unlike this granular giant platelet.
